summary.text: Melissa Douglas is a Democratic member of the Missouri House of Representatives who has represented District 27 since January 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Melissa Douglas graduated from Southwest High School in 1994, earned a bachelor's degree in business management from Idaho State University and a graduate degree in public administration from the University of Phoenix.
Her career experience includes working as the McKinney-Vento homeless liaison for Kansas City Public Schools.
Douglas was assigned to the House Budget and Professional Registration and Licensing committees for 2025-2026.
In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a lifelong Kansas City resident, a graduate of Kansas City Public Schools and an elected 17th ward Democratic committeewoman.
She listed public safety, education and community empowerment as her key campaign messages and said she is passionate about the state budget.
